mapper.select: /*selectBuyerMdCmExcelCartPunchoutSearch*/ SELECT A.BUYER_ITEM_NO AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, C.DESCRIPTION AS DESCRIPTION, C.SPECIFICATION AS SPECIFICATION, (SELECT COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY WHERE COM_CODE = C.AGENT) AS AGENT_NAME, NVL(A.CART_QTY,1) AS CART_QTY, DECODE(C.BUYER_ITEM_NO,NULL,'품목코드미등록')||DECODE(B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG,'Y','단종')||DECODE(C.STATUS,'D','삭제') AS ITEM_REMARK, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, A.USE_FLAG, A.BUYER, '' ITEM_TEXT FROM DOOSCART_ADD A, ICOMBYIT B, ICOMCQDT C WHERE A.BUYER = #{st_buyer} AND A.USER_ID = #{st_user_id} AND A.USE_FLAG = 'C' AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = B.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.BYIT_COMORG_CODE = C.BUYER(+) AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = C.BUYER_ITEM_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_NO = C.CONTRACT_NO(+) AND A.CONTRACT_SEQ = C.CONTRACT_SEQ(+) ORDER BY A.BUYER_ITEM_NO
mapper.update: /*insertMdCmExcelCart*/ INSERT INTO DOOSCART_ADD ( BUYER ,USER_ID ,CONTRACT_NO ,CONTRACT_SEQ ,ITEM_SEQ ,USE_FLAG ,BUYER_ITEM_NO ,SEQ ,DESCRIPTION ,SPECIFICATION ,AGENT ,CART_QTY ,REG_DATE ,BYIT_COMORG_CODE ,REF_PR_NO ,LIST_PRICE ,UNIT_PRICE ,REG_TIME ,ITEM_REMARK ) SELECT #{st_buyer}, #{st_user_id}, A.CONTRACT_NO, A.CONTRACT_SEQ, 'F0', 'C', A.BUYER_ITEM_NO, '1', A.DESCRIPTION, A.SPECIFICATION, A.AGENT, NVL(#{CART_QTY},1), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS REG_DATE, #{st_buyer}, 'EX' AS REF_PR_NO, A.LIST_PRICE, A.UNIT_PRICE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') AS REG_TIME, '' AS ITEM_REMARK FROM ICOMCQDT A, ICOMBYIT B WHERE A.BUYER =#{st_buyer} AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = UPPER(#{BUYER_ITEM_NO}) AND A.STATUS <> 'D' AND B.STATUS <> 'D' AND A.BUYER = B.BUYER AND A.BUYER_ITEM_NO = B.BUYER_ITEM_NO AND B.PRODUCT_CLOSE_FLAG IN ('N','A')
